text:
Madness already lifts its wing

to cover half my soul.

That taste of hypnotic wine!

Temptation of the dark valley!


Now everything is clear.

I admit my defeat. The language

of my deliriums in my ear

is the language of a foreigner.


Useless to fall to one's knees

and implore mercy.

Nothing that matters, except my life,

is mine to carry away:

not my son's terrible eyes,

not the chiseled stone flower

of pain, not the day of the storm,

not tribulation in the visiting hour,

not the dear coldness of his hands,

not the agitated shadow in the lime trees,

not the fine singing of the cricket

in the consoling word of departure.




1940

translation.title: Madness Already Lifts Its Wing
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the encroaching madness and the list of losses that cannot be carried away.
